title: Blowfish Algorithm with Examples - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Blowfish is an encryption technique designed by Bruce Schneier in 1993 as an alternative to the DES Encryption Technique. It is significantly faster than DES and provides a good encryption rate with no effective cryptanalysis technique found to date. It is one of the first secure block ciphers not subject to any patents and hence freely available for anyone to use. It is a symmetric block cipher algorithm.

  • blockSize: 64-bits
  • keySize: 32-bits to 448-bits variable size
  • Number of subkeys: 18 [P-array]
  • Number of rounds: 16
  • number of substitution boxes: 4 [each having 512 entries of 32 bits each]

Blowfish Encryption Algorithm

The entire encryption process can be elaborated as: 


Lets see each step one by one:

Step 1: Generation of subkeys 

  • 18 subkeys{P[0]...P[17]} are needed in both encryption as well as decryption process and the same subkeys are used for both the processes.
  • These 18 subkeys are stored in a P-array with each array element being a 32-bit entry.
  • It is initialized with the digits of pi(?).
  • The hexadecimal representation of each of the subkeys is given by:

P[0] = "243f6a88"
P[1] = "85a308d3"
.
.
.
P[17] = "8979fb1b"


Now each of the subkey is changed with respect to the input key as:

P[0] = P[0] xor 1st 32-bits of input key
P[1] = P[1] xor 2nd 32-bits of input key
.
.
.
P[i] = P[i] xor (i+1)th 32-bits of input key
(roll over to 1st 32-bits depending on the key length)
.
.
.
P[17] = P[17] xor 18th 32-bits of input key
(roll over to 1st 32-bits depending on key length)

The resultant P-array holds 18 subkeys that is used during the entire encryption process

Step 2: Initialize Substitution Boxes 

  • After expanding the P-array, The S-boxes are initialized with digits of pi.
  • 4 Substitution boxes(S-boxes) are needed{S[0]...S[4]} in both encryption aswell as decryption process with each S-box having 256 entries{S[i][0]...S[i][255], 0&lei&le4} where each entry is 32-bit.
  • It is initialized with the digits of Љ ( pi ) after initializing the P-array.

Step 3: Encryption 

  • The encryption function consists of two parts: 
    a. Rounds: The encryption consists of 16 rounds with each round(Ri) taking inputs the plainText(P.T.) from previous round and corresponding subkey(Pi). The description of each round is as follows:

Here, the function "add" is addition modulo 2^32.

    // P-array initial subkeys (18 entries)
    String[] P = { "243f6a88", "85a308d3", "13198a2e", "03707344",
                   "a4093822", "299f31d0", "082efa98", "ec4e6c89",
                   "452821e6", "38d01377", "be5466cf", "34e90c6c",
                   "c0ac29b7", "c97c50dd", "3f84d5b5", "b5470917",
                   "9216d5d9", "8979fb1b" };

    long modVal = 1L << 32; // 2^32

    // Convert hex string to binary string
    private String hexToBin(String hex) {
        StringBuilder binary = new StringBuilder();
        for (char c : hex.toCharArray()) {
            int val = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(c), 16);
            String bin4 = String.format("%4s", Integer.toBinaryString(val)).replace(' ', '0');
            binary.append(bin4);
        }
        return binary.toString();
    }

    // Convert binary string to hex string
    private String binToHex(String bin) {
        long num = Long.parseUnsignedLong(bin, 2);
        String hex = Long.toHexString(num);
        while (hex.length() < bin.length() / 4) {
            hex = "0" + hex;
        }
        return hex;
    }

    // XOR of two hex strings of same length
    private String xor(String a, String b) {
        String binA = hexToBin(a);
        String binB = hexToBin(b);
        StringBuilder res = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < binA.length(); i++) {
            res.append((binA.charAt(i) - '0') ^ (binB.charAt(i) - '0'));
        }
        return binToHex(res.toString());
    }

    // Addition modulo 2^32 of two hex strings
    private String addMod32(String a, String b) {
        long n1 = Long.parseUnsignedLong(a, 16);
        long n2 = Long.parseUnsignedLong(b, 16);
        long sum = (n1 + n2) % modVal;
        String res = Long.toHexString(sum);
        while (res.length() < 8) {
            res = "0" + res;
        }
        return res;
    }

    // The F function of Blowfish
    private String f(String x) {
        // x is 8 hex chars (32 bits)
        String[] parts = new String[4];
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            int index = Integer.parseInt(x.substring(i * 2, i * 2 + 2), 16);
            parts[i] = S[i % S.length][index];
        }
        String res = addMod32(parts[0], parts[1]);
        res = xor(res, parts[2]);
        res = addMod32(res, parts[3]);
        return res;
    }

    // Generate subkeys with key mixing
    private void keyGenerate(String key) {
        if (key.length() < 16) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Key must be at least 16 hex chars (64 bits)");
        }
        int j = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < P.length; i++) {
            P[i] = xor(P[i], key.substring(j, j + 8));
            j = (j + 8) % key.length();
        }
    }

    // One round of Blowfish
    private String round(int round, String data) {
        String left = data.substring(0, 8);
        String right = data.substring(8, 16);

        left = xor(left, P[round]);
        String fOut = f(left);
        right = xor(right, fOut);

        // Swap halves for next round
        return right + left;
    }

    // Encrypt 64-bit block
    private String encryptBlock(String block) {
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            block = round(i, block);
        }
        // Undo last swap
        String left = block.substring(8, 16);
        String right = block.substring(0, 8);

        left = xor(left, P[16]);
        right = xor(right, P[17]);

        return left + right;
    }

    // Expand P-array and S-boxes with the key
    private void expandKey() {
        String block = "0000000000000000";
        for (int i = 0; i < P.length; i += 2) {
            block = encryptBlock(block);
            P[i] = block.substring(0, 8);
            if (i + 1 < P.length) P[i + 1] = block.substring(8, 16);
        }
        for (int s = 0; s < S.length; s++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < S[s].length; i += 2) {
                block = encryptBlock(block);
                S[s][i] = block.substring(0, 8);
                if (i + 1 < S[s].length) S[s][i + 1] = block.substring(8, 16);
            }
        }
    }

    // Main encryption function
    private String encrypt(String plainText) {
        if (plainText.length() != 16) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Plaintext must be 16 hex chars (64 bits)");
        }
        return encryptBlock(plainText);
    }

    public Encryption() {
        String plainText = "123456abcd132536";
        String key = "aabb09182736ccdd";

        keyGenerate(key);
        expandKey();

        System.out.println("-----Encryption-----");
        String cipherText = encrypt(plainText);
        System.out.println("Cipher Text: " + cipherText);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Encryption();
    }

    // P-array initialization (18 entries)
    private static final String[] P = {
            "243f6a88", "85a308d3", "13198a2e", "03707344",
            "a4093822", "299f31d0", "082efa98", "ec4e6c89",
            "452821e6", "38d01377", "be5466cf", "34e90c6c",
            "c0ac29b7", "c97c50dd", "3f84d5b5", "b5470917",
            "9216d5d9", "8979fb1b"
    };

    // Instance copies of S and P to modify
    private String[][] sBoxes = new String[4][256];
    private String[] pArray = new String[18];

    private long modVal = 1L << 32; // 2^32

    public BlowfishDemo() {
        // Deep copy arrays to instance variables
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            System.arraycopy(S[i], 0, sBoxes[i], 0, 256);
        }
        System.arraycopy(P, 0, pArray, 0, 18);
    }

    private String hexToBin(String hex) {
        StringBuilder binary = new StringBuilder();
        for (char ch : hex.toCharArray()) {
            int val = Integer.parseInt(String.valueOf(ch), 16);
            String binStr = Integer.toBinaryString(val);
            binary.append("0000".substring(binStr.length())).append(binStr);
        }
        return binary.toString();
    }

    private String binToHex(String bin) {
        StringBuilder hex = new StringBuilder();
        for (int i = 0; i < bin.length(); i += 4) {
            String nibble = bin.substring(i, i + 4);
            hex.append(Integer.toHexString(Integer.parseInt(nibble, 2)));
        }
        return hex.toString();
    }

    private String xor(String a, String b) {
        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();
        String binA = hexToBin(a);
        String binB = hexToBin(b);
        for (int i = 0; i < binA.length(); i++) {
            result.append(binA.charAt(i) == binB.charAt(i) ? '0' : '1');
        }
        return binToHex(result.toString());
    }

    private String addHexMod32(String a, String b) {
        long valA = Long.parseUnsignedLong(a, 16);
        long valB = Long.parseUnsignedLong(b, 16);
        long sum = (valA + valB) % modVal;
        String hexSum = Long.toHexString(sum);
        while (hexSum.length() < 8) {
            hexSum = "0" + hexSum;
        }
        return hexSum;
    }

    private String f(String x) {
        // x is 8 hex chars = 32 bits
        // Split x into four 8-bit parts (2 hex chars each)
        String a = sBoxes[0][Integer.parseUnsignedInt(x.substring(0, 2), 16)];
        String b = sBoxes[1][Integer.parseUnsignedInt(x.substring(2, 4), 16)];
        String c = sBoxes[2][Integer.parseUnsignedInt(x.substring(4, 6), 16)];
        String d = sBoxes[3][Integer.parseUnsignedInt(x.substring(6, 8), 16)];

        String res = addHexMod32(a, b);
        res = xor(res, c);
        res = addHexMod32(res, d);

        return res;
    }

    private String encryptBlock(String block) {
        String left = block.substring(0, 8);
        String right = block.substring(8, 16);

        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++) {
            left = xor(left, pArray[i]);
            String fOut = f(left);
            right = xor(right, fOut);

            // Swap left and right for next round
            String temp = left;
            left = right;
            right = temp;
        }
        // Undo last swap
        String temp = left;
        left = right;
        right = temp;

        right = xor(right, pArray[16]);
        left = xor(left, pArray[17]);

        return left + right;
    }

    private String decryptBlock(String block) {
        String left = block.substring(0, 8);
        String right = block.substring(8, 16);

        for (int i = 17; i > 1; i--) {
            left = xor(left, pArray[i]);
            String fOut = f(left);
            right = xor(right, fOut);

            // Swap left and right
            String temp = left;
            left = right;
            right = temp;
        }
        // Undo last swap
        String temp = left;
        left = right;
        right = temp;

        right = xor(right, pArray[1]);
        left = xor(left, pArray[0]);

        return left + right;
    }

    // Key expansion
    private void keyExpansion(String key) {
        int keyLen = key.length();
        int j = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i++) {
            String keySegment = key.substring(j, j + 8);
            pArray[i] = xor(pArray[i], keySegment);
            j = (j + 8) % keyLen;
        }

        String block = "0000000000000000";
        for (int i = 0; i < 18; i += 2) {
            block = encryptBlock(block);
            pArray[i] = block.substring(0, 8);
            pArray[i + 1] = block.substring(8, 16);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 256; k += 2) {
                block = encryptBlock(block);
                sBoxes[i][k] = block.substring(0, 8);
                sBoxes[i][k + 1] = block.substring(8, 16);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        BlowfishDemo bf = new BlowfishDemo();

        // Sample 64-bit key and plaintext (hex, 16 chars = 64 bits)

        // 32 hex chars (128 bits)
        String key = "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"; 
        // 64-bit plaintext block
        String plaintext = "FEDCBA9876543210";

        bf.keyExpansion(key);

        String cipherText = bf.encryptBlock(plaintext);
        System.out.println("Cipher Text: " + cipherText);

        String decryptedText = bf.decryptBlock(cipherText);
        System.out.println("Decrypted Text: " + decryptedText);
    }

Advantages

  • Blowfish is a fast block cipher except when changing keys. Each new key requires a pre-processing equivalent to 4KB of text.
  • It is faster and much better than DES Encryption.

Disadvantages

  • Blowfish uses a 64-bit block size which makes it vulnerable to birthday attacks.
  • A reduced round variant of blowfish is known to be susceptible to known plain text attacks(2nd order differential attacks - 4 rounds). 
     

Application of Blowfish Algorithm

  • Bulk Encryption.
  • Packet Encryption(ATM Packets)
  • Password Hashing
